class.name: NetwJoinRequest
class.brief_description: A player's request to join a session.

method.name: add_account
method.description: Adds [param account] with the display [param name] to [member accounts], from [method NetwAccountProvider._verify]. Pass [code]false[/code] for [param answers_challenge] when the proof does not depend on [member challenge]. An account already listed keeps its place.

method.name: is_bound
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when another server of this game could not have passed on the proof of [param account]. That holds when the transport reports the account, or when its proof answered a [member challenge] bound to this server, as over WebRTC or through a [LobbyDirectory] that reports the server's account.

method.name: name_of
method.description: Returns the display name proven with [param account], or [code]""[/code].

members.member: The account the new [NetwPlayer] takes, such as [code]"steam:76561198000000000"[/code]. Starts as the first of [member accounts]. Empty for a guest.
The display name for [member account]. Starts as the name of the first of [member accounts].
Every account proven for this join. Each [NetwAccountProvider]'s comes first, in the order they were accepted, then the account the serving [LobbyDirectory] reports.
The arguments of [method Netw.prepare_join], decoded with the types declared by [method Netw.configure_join].
The challenge every [NetwAccountProvider] proved on the joining peer, or [code]""[/code] when none is accepted.
The server's session the peer is joining.
